dogecoin.text:
The evolution is fascinating:

1️⃣ 2013: Dogecoin emerges as a "joke" project requiring technical expertise
2️⃣ 2024: https://t.co/AZkoWutFEb launches on Solana, creates 2M+ tokens in months
3️⃣ 2025: Specialized launchpads emerge across multiple blockchains

The evolution has been rapid:

2013: @dogecoin launches, requires technical expertise
2024: Platforms like @pump_fun emerge, letting you create tokens for ~$5
2025: Multi-chain expansion across @solana, @BNBCHAIN, @trondao & more

Technical barriers? Gone. 💨
